description: This file defines React components wrapping Radix UI's Collapsible primitives for use as collapsible UI elements in a Next.js frontend application.

methods.name: Collapsible
methods.description: A React component that wraps Radix's CollapsiblePrimitive.Root to create a collapsible container.

methods.name: CollapsibleTrigger
methods.description: A React component that wraps Radix's CollapsiblePrimitive.CollapsibleTrigger, serving as the toggle for the collapsible content.

methods.name: CollapsibleContent
methods.description: A React component that wraps Radix's CollapsiblePrimitive.CollapsibleContent, displaying the content shown or hidden.
